title: ArmTrailRequest
description: Update payload for PositionWorkflow.arm_trail — the OPERATOR entry point into the existing CHANDELIER_TRAIL machinery (PLAN-2026-08-16-live-operator-trailing-stop). Deliberately an Update rather than reusing the armChandelier SIGNAL: an arm can be refused (bad giveback, unresolvable anchor, market-data subscribe failure), and a signal cannot report that, so the operator would be told a real-money position is protected when it is not. Scope is ONE position — the target is a single PositionWorkflow execution; it does not change strategy_config.trail_giveback_pct and so has no effect on any other or future position.

operator_id.description: Verified operator identity, threaded by api-gateway from the session — never client-supplied. Recorded on the ChandelierArmed audit event for attribution.

giveback_pct.description: Trailing giveback fraction. fire_threshold = peak * (1 - giveback_pct), recomputed as the peak rises, so the stop moves UP and never down. Capped at 0.5 to match PositionWorkflowImpl.MAX_GIVEBACK and the strategy-config trail_giveback_pct bound — a looser value is rejected by the workflow, so it is rejected here first.

peak_premium.description: OPTIONAL anchor override. Omit it in normal operation: the workflow then resolves the anchor itself as max(its own tracked peak, a fresh quote), which is strictly better than anything a browser can supply — a page-rendered premium is seconds stale, and an anchor that is too low sets the stop too low on a real-money position. Present only for the rare case where an operator must pin the anchor deliberately.
